summary: NextSync 0.2.3: fixes the main window crash on libadwaita 1.6+.
changelog: Fixed the main window crash on libadwaita 1.6+: Adw.NavigationSplitView now takes NavigationPage objects for sidebar and content instead of the removed sidebar/content keyword form.
NextSync now opens its main window reliably on current GNOME/Libadwaita.
